requirements.text: SCALE UP — Execute the D-045 campaign with parallel production: up to 3 concurrent writing producers on disjoint D-045 family/connector tasks, each dispatched into its own isolated worktree under the standing orchestration policy (.claude/ORCHESTRATION_POLICY.md). Apply from the next A1 wave onward wherever ready tasks with disjoint scopes exist.
requirements.required_harness: dispatch records / progress log show concurrent producers on disjoint D-045 tasks
requirements.required_evidence: campaign waves executed with >1 concurrent producer where disjoint ready tasks existed

requirements.text: DISJOINTNESS IS MANDATORY — Never dispatch two concurrent writing producers whose allowed_paths overlap any file. Family tasks are contracted so scopes are provably disjoint (per-family rule files, tests, fixtures); shared surfaces (registry wiring, coverage tables, shared schemas) are integrated sequentially by the orchestrator, never edited in parallel.
requirements.required_harness: task packets' allowed_paths pairwise-disjoint for concurrently dispatched producers
requirements.required_evidence: no concurrent dispatch with overlapping scopes in the campaign record

requirements.text: NO QUALITY RELAXATION — Parallelism changes execution shape only. Unchanged and non-waivable: independent review (producer ≠ reviewer, reviewers read-only), all G0–G7 gates, dependency policy §G including the 7-day age gate, sequential integration and sole ledger/git/gh authority of the orchestrator (ADR-005/ADR-006 tiers), directive-compliance verification, and careful legal sourcing for every rule. Parallelism is never cited to skip, thin, batch-waive, or self-approve review.
requirements.required_harness: gate records per task unchanged in kind and independence
requirements.required_evidence: every campaign task carries the full gate set with producer ≠ reviewer

requirements.text: RESOURCE BACKPRESSURE — Concurrency ceiling is 3 writing producers. On resource pressure (usage caps, model unavailability, CI contention, review backlog), reduce concurrency and keep quality rather than queueing degraded work; the owner is informed only on major stalls per the standing quiet-monitoring rule. Ordering judgment stays with the orchestrator (D-045-R008 unchanged).
requirements.required_harness: orchestrator practice; progress log on any backoff
requirements.required_evidence: no quality incident attributed to over-parallelization

requirements.text: RELAY / ACKNOWLEDGMENT (return item) — The companion session relays this directive to the live build session; the build session acknowledges and applies it from the next dispatch wave. Discharged when the build session confirms and the first parallel wave is recorded.
requirements.required_harness: cross-session message + acknowledgment; first parallel dispatch recorded
requirements.required_evidence: message in this capture's audit_log; subsequent dispatch record
